privileged_info_for_vlm: Verified values for the JSON: Methanol: CAS 67-56-1, MW ~32.04, Tc ~512.6-513.15 K, Pc ~80.97 bar. Toluene: CAS 108-88-3, MW ~92.14, Tc ~591.75 K, Pc ~41.0-41.1 bar. R-134a (1,1,1,2-Tetrafluoroethane): CAS 811-97-2, MW ~102.03, Tc ~374.2 K, Pc ~40.6 bar. Note: NIST often lists pressure in MPa (1 MPa = 10 bar) or atm (1 atm = 1.01325 bar); ensure the agent converted to bar correctly.
